description: Freelancer payout agent for the USDT to cNGN corridor on Textile FX, built for Celo mainnet (chain 42220). Built for the Celo Agents Open for Business hackathon (Track 1, Stablecoin Corridors). A client pays USDT; the agent takes a firm Textile RFQ v2 quote as a taker, converts to cNGN, and pays a named freelancer in cNGN in one tagged onchain flow. Every transaction carries the Loops attribution tag. The engine prices every conversion from the live Textile USDT_NGN mid, sanity-checked against an independent NGN/USD reference, with EWMA volatility, inventory skew, hard size caps, and kill switches on excess spread or reference divergence. The firm price must beat fair value by more than fee plus gas plus a minimum edge, or the run halts and logs why. Currently runs in dry-run mode: preview and planning against the live Textile RFQ are tested; the first live payout waits on the payee being named and the agent wallet being funded.
name: NairaQuote Pay
